Methods

Draw(Line, float, float, ColorRgba)

Draws a line using a Line object, with the specified length, thickness, and color.

public static void Draw(this Line line, float length, float thickness, ColorRgba color)

Parameters

line Line

The Line object to draw.

length float

The length of the line.

thickness float

The thickness of the line.

color ColorRgba

The color of the line.

Remarks

If line is not valid, or length is less than or equal to 0, or thickness is less than or equal to 0, the line is not drawn.

DrawLine(Vector2, Vector2, float, float, ColorRgba)

Draws a line at a given point, in a specified direction, with a given length, thickness, and color.

public static void DrawLine(Vector2 point, Vector2 direction, float length, float thickness, ColorRgba color)

Parameters

point Vector2

The center point of the line.

direction Vector2

The normalized direction vector of the line.

length float

The length of the line.

thickness float

The thickness of the line.

color ColorRgba

The color of the line.

Remarks

If length is less than or equal to 0, thickness is less than or equal to 0, or direction is a zero vector, the line is not drawn.

DrawMasked(Line, float, Circle, LineDrawingInfo, bool)

Draws a masked portion of the line centered on line with the specified length, using the provided Circle mask and drawing parameters in lineInfo.

public static void DrawMasked(this Line line, float length, Circle mask, LineDrawingInfo lineInfo, bool reversedMask = false)

Parameters

line Line

The source Line. Must be valid to draw.

length float

Total length of the segment to draw (must be greater than 0).

mask Circle

Circle mask used to clip the drawn segment.

lineInfo LineDrawingInfo

Line drawing configuration (thickness, color, etc.).

reversedMask bool

If true, draws the parts inside the mask instead of outside.

DrawMasked<T>(Line, float, T, LineDrawingInfo, bool)

Draws a masked portion of the line centered on line with the specified length, using a mask of generic type T which implements IClosedShapeTypeProvider.

public static void DrawMasked<T>(this Line line, float length, T mask, LineDrawingInfo lineInfo, bool reversedMask = false) where T : IClosedShapeTypeProvider

Parameters

line Line

The source Line. Must be valid to draw.

length float

Total length of the segment to draw (must be greater than 0).

mask T

Mask used to clip the drawn segment.

lineInfo LineDrawingInfo

Line drawing configuration (thickness, color, etc.).

reversedMask bool

If true, draws the parts inside the mask instead of outside.

Type Parameters

T

The mask type that provides a closed shape for clipping (must implement IClosedShapeTypeProvider).

Remarks

If line is not valid, length is less than or equal to 0, or lineInfo has non-positive thickness, nothing will be drawn.
